metadata.name: VISAPushProvisioning
metadata.description: Push provisioning allows issuer mobile apps to push customer’s PAN data securely to participating third-party Wallet Providers for VTS token provisioning.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example: 12345

request_fields.name: cvv2
request_fields.description: Description: CVV2 value of Card.

request_fields.name: Name
request_fields.description: The full name on the Visa card associated with the enrolled payment instrument. Allowable Values: 256

request_fields.name: ExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Group with details of Expiration of Card

request_fields.name: BillingAddress
request_fields.description: Billing address associated with the payment instrument.

request_fields.name: intent
request_fields.description: Description: The intent of the encryptor. Valid Values: PUSH_PROV_MOBILE, PUSH_PROV_ONFILE

request_fields.name: isIDnV
request_fields.description: Description: String field to specify if the Issuer wants IDandV to be performed. Valid Values: "true" or "false"

request_fields.name: Month
request_fields.description: The month when the card will expire. Valid Values: 1-12

request_fields.name: Year
request_fields.description: The year when card will expire. Format: CCYY

request_fields.name: line1
request_fields.description: Address Line one of card holder. Valid Values: a-z A-Z 0-9 Symbols: .,'-_#:/ Allowable Values: 140

request_fields.name: line2
request_fields.description: Primary Address Line one of card holder. Valid Values: a-z A-Z 0-9 Symbols: .,'-_#:/ Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: city
request_fields.description: City of the Cardholder Address Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: state
request_fields.description: State of Cardholder. Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: country
request_fields.description: Country in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format, eg "US". Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: The postal code associated with the enrolled payment instrument. Permitted characters: A-Z a-z 0-9 Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: clientAppID
request_fields.description: Unique identifier for the client application, used to provide some of the encrypted values. Required if intent is "PUSH_PROV_MOBILE". Allowable Values: 36

request_fields.name: clientDeviceID
request_fields.description: Stable device identification set by Wallet Provider. Required if intent is "PUSH_PROV_MOBILE". Valid Values: [0-9,A-Z,a-z,-,_] Allowable Values: 24

request_fields.name: clientWalletProvider
request_fields.description: Client Wallet Provider is the token requestor’s ID (TRID), which is returned to the WP as part of onboarding. Valid Values: [0-9,A-Z,a-z,-,_] Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: clientWalletAccountID
request_fields.description: Client-provided consumer ID that identifies the Wallet Account. Valid Values: Valid Values 0-9,A-Z,a-z,-,_] Allowable Values: 24

request_fields.name: intent
request_fields.description: The intent of the encryptor. Valid Values: PUSH_PROV_MOBILE, PUSH_PROV_ONFILE

request_fields.name: IdentityVerificationRequired
request_fields.description: String field to specify if the Issuer wants Identity Verification to be performed. Valid Values: "true" or "false"

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ErrorFound
children.description: Indicates result of API processing. If error found then "Yes", else "No".

children.name: ErrorNumber
children.description: Return Error Code in case of Error.

children.name: ErrorMessage
children.description: Return Error Message in case of Error.

children.name: AdminNumber
children.description: Admin Number of Primary Account Number.

children.name: EncryptedPayload
children.description: Encrypted Payload calculated over the field values of Input.
